item.title: Car strikes Dunkin’ in Brewster
item.description: BREWSTER – A car struck the Dunkin’ on Lower Road in Brewster. The crash happened sometime after 9:30 AM Friday. The driver was evaluated by EMTs. A building inspector was called to check the extent of the damage. Further details were not immediately available. The post Car strikes Dunkin’ in Brewster appeared first on CapeCod.com.

item.title: Bourne Bridge closed after double rollover crash
item.description: BOURNE – The Bourne Bridge was closed about 7:45 PM Saturday after a reported head-on crash that caused both vehicles to overturn. Firefighters had to extricate at one person from the wreckage. The injuries did not appear to be life-threatening. item.title: Two people taken to hospital after three-vehicle crash in Mashpee
item.description: MASHPEE – Two people were transported to Cape Cod Hospital after a three-vehicle crash in Mashpee about 10 PM Saturday. The collision happened on Falmouth Road (Route 28) at Orchard Road. Route 28 was closed in the area while the scene was worked. The cause of the crash is under investigation by Mashpee Police. item.title: Brewster Fire rescues two people in distress on a trail near Wings Neck Beach
item.description: BREWSTER – Two people and a dog were rescued by Brewster firefighters after running into distress on a trail near Wings Neck Beach. Crews put the people in survival suits to get through the ice to safety. They were evaluated for possible hypothermia. item.title: Pedestrian struck and critically injured in Wareham
item.description: WAREHAM – A pedestrian was reportedly struck by a car in Wareham about 8:45 PM Sunday evening. The incident happened on Cranberry Highway (Route 28) west of Glen Charlie Road. The victim reportedly suffered potentially life-threatening injuries. The highway was closed while crash reconstruction was done. Further details were not immediately available.
